 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.152 of 2024 registered at Police Station Khargapur District Tikamgarh (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 366, 266, 376,
368 of IPC and Sections 5/6 and 16/17 of the POCSO Act.
The earlier application registered as MCrC No.32543 of 2024 was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to repeat the same after filing of the charge sheet.

It is submitted that similarly placed co-accused namely Chhotelal @ Dashrath and Ku. Sonam Ahirwar have already been released on bail vide orders dated 02.09.2024 and 09.09.2024 passed in MCrC Nos. 35995 of 2024 and 37780 of 2024 respectively.
Charge sheet has been filed in the matter.
The main accused is Monu Ahirwar.
The applicant is in custody since 15.07.2024.
She is ready to abide by all terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering this bail application.
On these NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46018 2 MCRC-39045-2024 grounds, prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Per contra, State counsel has opposed the bail application but could not dispute the factum of parity with the aforesaid co-accused.

sentences.text: Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application on the ground of parity.
Accordingly, the application is allowed subject to verification of the fact that the applicant is a first offender.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing surety bond of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the conditions as enumerated under Section 437(3) of CrPC.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
The application is accordingly allowed in above terms.
